sections.heading: AI-native design systems: authority engine (Oct 2026 – Mar 2027)
sections.text:
Owner: Raquel Pereira · Sponsor: Pragathi Kanth · Loop: Hugo, Carlos (weekly update)
Board: FigJam DS-Practice → page Initiatives (453:1978)

sections.heading: The mandate (Pragathi, 20 Oct 2026)
sections.text:
Take full ownership of amplifying AI-native design systems internally and externally:
- Build authority by openly sharing what to do and how.
- Keep the energy up every day, without gatekeeping.
- Goal: attract clients and prospects. Execution capacity sits elsewhere.

sections.heading: Big idea
sections.text:
**"AI will build your interfaces anyway. Make sure it builds *yours*."**
It extends the campaign line "One foundation. Shared by people and AI."

Vocabulary:
- AI-ready is the system: tokens, metadata, rules, checks.
- AI-native is how the organisation designs and builds with agents (Figma's term in its AI-native org guide).
- Use both deliberately.

sections.heading: The spine: Problem → Proof → Pipeline
sections.text:
1. Collect real problems from Experience Day, client managers, the scorecard, nominations and Viva Engage, each with anonymous-use consent. See problem-bank.md.
2. Solve one visibly each month, anonymised, on the fictional demo brand: Beyond Pixels → LinkedIn → talks.
3. Turn it into content: clip, carousel, article, podcast prompt, battle-card objection.
4. Route to pipeline: scorecard → 30-min readout → 2-week AI audit → DS Build / Accelerate / Scale. The problem's owner gets a private follow-up from their client manager.

sections.heading: Attention magnets
sections.text:
The reference pattern is Meta's Astryx (astryx.atmeta.com; open-sourced June 2026, MIT licence, public beta):
- "An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready".
- React + StyleX, 150+ components, MCP + CLI.
- The landing page *is* the demo: shop, checkout, dashboard, AI assistant.

Pushback: we cannot out-library Meta (8 years, ~13k internal apps). Our public piece shows *how to make your own system like this*, including brownfield systems (ones that already exist). It does not compete as a library. Our edge is the AI layer + an adapter for systems that already exist.

Rank · Magnet · Why · Built from

1 · Public AI-readiness scorecard · We found no free AI-readiness grader for design systems. Precedents: HubSpot Website Grader (250k sites in its first year), Sparkbox maturity assessment · The existing assessment (score out of 21) + Handbook rules + DSN index
2 · Public demo-brand DS (D8), Astryx pattern · Shows the method on realistic enterprise screens (bank, retail, automotive); agent-ready docs, MCP, "prompt a screen" · DSN + Starter Pack + prototyping-kit pattern
3 · "On-system or not?" game · Can't Unsee / Method.ac format; teaches drift in 2 minutes; event booth · Demo brand screens
4 · Guided AI demo (later) · Sable (Figma uses it) is waitlist-only and enterprise-priced. Start with an Arcade/Navattic click-through · Configurator

Content formats:
- before/after sliders
- 60 s vertical demos
- "Explain it to your CFO" posts
- benchmark data posts
- free AGENTS.md / DESIGN.md / skills templates
- 1-page checklists
- myth-vs-fact carousels

- twice-yearly "AI-ready DS Radar" (Thoughtworks Radar format)
